maddeler.e:
ننفصم (form VII)
# نَنْفَصِمُ (nanfaṣimu) /nan.fa.sˤi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# نَنْفَصِمَ (nanfaṣima) /nan.fa.sˤi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# نَنْفَصِمْ (nanfaṣim) /nan.fa.sˤim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
